newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Imsa raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Imsa raised.

text.p: The Banacci brokerage on Monday raised its recommendation on Mexican steel company Grupo Imsa SA de CV to buy from neutral, Banacci said in a report.
--Analyst Arturo Espinosa said Imsa shares have lagged behind others in the steel sector at a time when Banacci saw no reason to change its long-term outlook for the stock.
--"We are changing our recommendation from neutral to buy and have not changed our price objective of 36 pesos for December 1998," Espinoza wrote.
--Imsa was seen outperforming the Mexican bolsa through the end of 1998.
--Imsa shares closed down five centavos to 25 pesos on Monday. In New York, Imsa shares closed down 1/8 to 28-3/4.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom, +525 728-7912))
